blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Wednesday commended Filipino pole vaulter Ernest John “EJ” Obiena for winning the gold medal at a recent competition in Germany. READ: EJ Obiena strikes gold again at Germany pole vault meet In a voice vote, lawmakers adopted House Resolution No. 1480, titled “Resolution Commending and Congratulating Filipino Pole Vault Athlete Ernest John ‘EJ’ Uy Obiena for Winning the Gold Medal at the Halberstadter Hohenflug International Pole Vault Meeting Held at the Historic Cathedral Square (Domplatz) in Halberstadt, Germany.” The resolution was filed by House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III, Majority Floor Leader Sandro […]...
